parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent (SYS-01 to SYS-05): V-001 separates gas, oil and free water by density difference at nominal 60 psig/130 °F. Water goes to treatment, gas to fuel gas with excess to the burn pit, and oil to the Heater–Treater and then V-003. All six source-study elements (SYS-07) were examined with applicable guidewords (SYS-08), giving 14 findings across the full node boundary: inlet, gas/oil/water outlets, E-001 and relief. With no frequency data, prioritization is consequence-driven. High pressure, low level/interface (gas blow-by to Heater–Treater or water treatment) and high level (liquid carry-over to fuel gas and burn pit) carry loss-of-containment and fire/explosion potential and rank highest, followed by fire exposure and blocked outlets. The only source-supported procedural item, FWKO start-up without bypass opening, is a human_procedural finding whose severity stays unresolved until the bypass function is known. Low temperature is assessed on packet evidence as an E-001-related separation-quality deviation of lower severity; the salient vignette was not treated as evidence. Safeguard credit is limited to SYS-06 tags whose functions, set points and independence need verification. Priority actions are reconciling the pressure/temperature basis, verifying PSV-101 A/B sizing and discharge, and confirming independent pressure, level and temperature alarms/trips.
